headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate real-time dependency risk assessment tools to provide users with up-to-date security and compatibility information. Incorporate machine learning models for predictive analysis of potential issues during installation. Implement a user-friendly interface that highlights risks associated with specific dependencies.
actions: Integrate Minireel/HGhub's real-time dependency scanning capabilities to ensure all installed packages are secure and up-to-date.
Use janestreet/agent_skills to implement machine learning models for predictive analysis, identifying potential issues before installation.
Develop a user-friendly interface that visually highlights risks associated with specific dependencies, guiding users through the installation process.
